source.source_title: Automatic Emergency Parking Brakes (as required by 30 CFR 75.523-3)
source.why_this_clip: A black hose arcs from a metal hose reel against a wood wall, and a hand enters from the right, grips the hose and pulls it so the loop shifts and tightens. This interval covers the hand's grab and pull; the only cut is at 18.75 s, and the later reel rotation from 9 s on moves only the reel's red handle, not the hose.
